Commentary.Commentary: Things look in Pakistan's favour but you never know what the World No. l T20I team can pull out of their hat. Join us shortly for the run chase.

Imad Wasim was the man to make the breakthrough and ensured that the Windies stayed down. He picked up a five-wicket haul, the first ever in T20I history and gave away a paltry 14 runs. The other bowlers did well too, limiting the visitors to a total of 115 with Tanvir picking up two wickets of his own.

With 8 wickets down and 48 runs on the board the situation seemed nigh impossible. However, Bravo and Taylor came in to save face for the Men from the Caribbeans. They put up a 66-run partnership to stablize the innings. Bravo led from the front with a hard-earned 55.

An incredible comeback by the Windies! And it is all thanks to a tremendous innings by Bravo. Pakistan's bowlers came after the batsmen from the word go and West Indies' batters couldn't seem to stay at the crease for long.

OUT! That's the end of the Windies innings! Full and outside off, Bravo goes for a big shot. The ball goes down the ground at long on where Akmal takes an easy catch. A hard fought innings of Bravo comes to an end. WINDIES ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 115!
Hurls it full around off, Bravo lofts it to long on but doesn't take a run.
Short ball around off, Badree pulls it to the leg side for a single
Samuel Badree is the last man in.

OUT! Bowled him! Yorker in the blockhole. Taylor moves across to flick it away but misses the line of the ball completely. The ball hits him on the pads and crashes into the pads. A good partnership is broken.
Full ball around off, driven to mid off for a single.
Wide! Full ball wide outside off, a play and a miss but it is given as a wide.

Confusion there! Length ball around middle and off, Taylor plays the ramp shot which goes towards the third man region. The ball lands safely between the third man fielder and the keeper though. There is a throw at the striker's end but the batsman just makes it in. Had there been a direct hit, Taylor would have been a goner. Brace taken.
Short ball around off, pulled to the leg side for a single.
4th T20I fifty for Dwayne Bravo.
SIX! Smashed! Full around off, Bravo stays back and sends it over covers for well placed biggie. What a knock under pressure from this champion player. A bail out knock so far.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Bravo looks to steer that but misses it.

Tough chance! Slower ball outside off, Bravo a bit early into his shot and ends up pulling it. The ball goes high up in the air and Wahab runs for it. He covers some distance towards mid wicket, gets his hands on it but fails to keep an hold of it. Brace taken.
Full length ball around middle and off, Bravo drives it straight to covers for a single.
Short ball wide outside off, Bravo tries to play an upper cut but fails to connect.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Taylor looks to heave that but misses.
Slower ball outside off, a play and a miss from Taylor.

Full ball outside off, Bravo cuts it to point. Taylor is looking for a run and the throw is fired at the non-striker's end. he misses and then the batsmen cross for a run because of the overthrow. Single taken at the end.
Tanvir back on.
Short ball around middle and off. Taylor ducks to let it through.
50-run stand between Taylor and Bravo.
Short ball on middle and leg, Taylor goes for a pull but it goes off the top edge over the keeper's head. Brace taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Length ball outside off, Taylor goes for a big shot but misses it.
Perfect length ball around middle and leg, a play and a miss and the ball goes over the stumps, back to the keeper.
FOUR! Another well placed boundary! Bowls it fuller around off,  Taylor cuts it fine over backward point for a valuable boundary.
Free Hit coming up.
No ball! Wahab overstep and bowls it around off, nudged to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Well-executed! Bowls it wide and outside off, Taylor is ready to paddle it but follows the ball and plays it over third man for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up.
No ball! A high full toss on middle and off. Bravo plays it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Muscled away! Short ball around middle and leg. Bravo stays deep in his crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a well placed boundary.
Bowls it full on middle and leg, Taylor plays it to mid off for a single.
Hurls it fuller on middle and off, Bravo looks to play it with the straight bat but it goes off an inside edge to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Sliced away! Full ball around middle and off, Bravo stays deep in his crease and slices it away through backward point for a boundary.
Wide! Bouncer on middle and leg, Bravo leaves it and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Length ball around middle and leg, Bravo pushes to the wide of mid on and takes a brace. Good placement and running there from Bravo.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Shorter ball outside off, Bravo rocks back and punches it off the back foot for a single.
Defended from within the crease off the back foot.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Fuller ball down the leg side, Bravo times it excellently and works it behind square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, Taylor looks to play it to the leg side but misses and is hit high on the pads. A loud appeal goes up but the umpire doesn't agree. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
SIX! Over the top! Fuller ball on off, Bravo leans forward, and gets it right in the slot. He lofts the ball over mid off and extra cover for a gigantic maximum.
Tanvir back on.
A slower ball wide outside off, Taylor tries to play at it but it was out of his reach.
A perfect length ball outside off, Taylor tries to cut it away but misses.
Wide! A wayward length down the leg side, left alone and wide so signaled.
Similar line and Taylor attempts a flick but is hit on the pads.
Leg bye! Serves it on the leg stump line. Bravo moves to his right and tries to run that fine but is hit on the pads. The batsmen cross for a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, a play and a miss from Bravo.
Serves it full on middle and leg, Bravo clears his front foot and looks to go up and over but miscues it to the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! DOWNTOWN! Serves it full on middle and off, Taylor confidently lofts it over long off for a maximum. Good shot that in such a situation.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Floats it around off, played to the off side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended neatly.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nawaz back on.
Slower bouncer on middle and leg. Bravo tries to play at it but gets into an awkward position. The ball goes off his arm to the off side.
Full ball on middle and leg, Bravo misses his flick shot and is hit on the pads.
Length ball on off, cut to point.
Jerome Taylor to bat next.

OUT! RUN OUT! LATIF WITH A BULL'S EYE! Bowls it full around off, Narine off his front foot drives it to mid off and sets off for a run. Latif collects the ball and fires it at the non-striker's end. Sunil is well short of his crease and has to go back in a disappointment.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs against Narine.
Back of a length ball outside off, Narine taps it to point.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Wahab Riaz to bowl now.
Bowls it full around off, cut to point for a single.
Sunil Narine is the next batsman.

OUT! 5-fer for Wasim! Tossed up ball around middle and leg. Carlos kneels down and looks to paddle sweep it. The ball catches the top edge and it balloons over the wicketkeeper. Latif moves to his left from the first slip to gobble an easy catch. The Caribbean side is in serious trouble after that fall of wickets.
Serves it full around middle and off, blocked neatly.
Carlos Brathwaite is the new man in.

OUT! Pollard departs! Darts it full around middle and leg. Pollard looks to run that to the leg side but he misses the line of the ball. It goes on to hit his thigh-pad and crash into the stumps. Wasim gets his fourth wicket. Windies are in a big trouble now.
Tossed up ball around off, Bravo drives it through covers for a single.
Darts it full around middle and off. Bravo plays it confidently to the covers but Imad and the wicketkeeper were asking for an LBW appeal. The umpire turns it down.
Bowls it full and outside off, Pollard tries to cut it fine but misses the line of the ball.
Hurls it fuller on the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Good stop there in the deep! Tossed up ball around off,  Pollard heaves it with power down the ground. Malik in the deep runs to his left and saves some valuable runs. Single taken.
Darts it full and quicker through the air around off. Pollard stays tall and punches it back to the bowler.
Bowls it on the pads, Bravo leans ahead and turns the ball to mid-wicket for a single.
Darts it full on middle and off, Bravo strides ahead and cuts it late to point for no runs.
Nawaz back on.
Floats it on off, driven to covers for a run by Bravo.
Serves it quicker on the pads, Pollard bunts it to mid-wicket for a single.
Darts it fuller on middle and leg, Bravo flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Pollard punches it to covers. A good stop there by the fielder.
Serves it fuller on the stumps, it goes on to hit the pads of the batsman.
Imad Wasim is back on.
On the pads, Pollard nudges it to fine leg for a single.
That was close! Slants in a length ball, Bravo off his front foot tries to defend it. The ball catches an inside edge, is deflected onto the pads and goes to third man for a single.
Length ball around middle and off, Pollard drives it down the ground for a single.
Length ball around middle and off, Bravo steers it fine through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short ball on middle and leg, Bravo camps back and pulls it with his might through deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Good shot under pressure from Dwayne.
Length ball outside off, Pollard looks to play it through covers but it goes off the outside edge through first slip for a single.
Hasan Ali changes ends.
Serves it full on the pads, flicked to the leg side for another single.
Short and wide outside off, bravo camps back and cuts it to point for a single.
Loopy ball on the pads, Pollard works it down the leg side for a single.
Serves it quicker through the air around middle and off, pushed to covers for a single.
Floats it fuller on middle and leg, defended to the on side. Sarfraz runs, dives and saves a single.
Wide! Bowls it down the leg side, wide given.
What a ball from Malik. It goes on the off side after pitching on middle. Bravo punches it to covers.
Shoaib Malik will roll his arm now.
Floats it around middle and leg, played to the leg side for a single.
Darts it fuller on the pads, Bravo strides forward and looks to block. It is miscued to the on side and a half-hearted appeal is turned down too.
Bowls it full and around off. Pollard defends it to the on side and scurries for a quick run.
Darts it on the pads, pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball on middle and off, neatly defended.
Darts it around on off, played to the covers.
Length ball on middle and off, blocked neatly.
A perfect length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball on middle and off, played to point.
Kieron Pollard is the next man in.

OUT! The Debutant goes early! Serves it full outside off. Pooran looks to cut it fine and gets  a thick edge which goes straight into the gloves of Sarfraz. Hasan Ali joins the wicket column too. The tourists are struggling big time here.
FOUR! Flicked away! Full ball around middle and off. Pooran off his back foot flicks it away in a jiffy towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, pushed to covers.
Hasan Ali to bowl next.
The batsman has edged that one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Nicholas Pooran is the new batsman, the debutant.

OUT! Nawaz gets the prized wicket of Charles! Serves it fuller on the stumps. Charles goes wide in his crease to crash it through the covers but misses the line of the ball completely. The ball disturbs the furniture and Windies are four down now. The spin-duo has kick started this match with a bang.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Loopy ball on middle and off, defended to mid on for a quick run.
Floats it full and it is played to the off side.
Mohammad Nawaz to bowl now.
On the pads, played to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dwayne Bravo is the new batsman now.

OUT! Imad gets his third wicket! Darts it full around middle and off, Marlon gets trapped off his front foot and fails to bring his bat in time. The ball hits the pads first and then the bat. The lbw appeals are roaring out and the umpire gives it out too. Wasim is prolific with his bowling tonight.
FOUR! Cut away! Loopy ball outside off, Samuels cuts it away through point for a well struck boundary.
Marlon Samuels is the new man in.

OUT ! Cleaned him up! Bowls it quicker through the air around middle and off. Fletcher off his front foot tries to play at it but is beaten and the ball disturbs the woodwork. West Indies are two down now. Imad on a roll.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Cheeky! Serves it outside off, Charles runs it fine by opening the face of the bat at the last minute. It races away to the third man boundary in a jiffy.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide. Serves it wide outside off, it is given as a wide.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Serves it on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Sohail Tanvir will bowl from the other end.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Andre Fletcher is the new man in.

OUT! Imad draws first blood! Tossed up ball around middle and off. Lewis goes for a slog sweep as the ball was there to be hit. Evin kneels and connects it, the ball goes in the deep mid-wicket region off the top edge. A well-judged catch is taken by Nawaz and Pakistan are up on their feet. The dangerman departs.
Floater ball and it is played well in time off his back foot.
Flighted ball around middle and off, Charles punches off his back foot for a single.
Serves it on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for another run.
Tossed up ball outside off, cut to point for a run. OFF THE MARK, WINDIES!
The players and the umpires walk out in the middle and the two openers for West Indies are Evin Lewis and Johnson Charles. Imad Wasim will bowl first up. Here we go...
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and elect to bowl first.

Sarfraz Ahmed will captain the Pakistan T20I side for the second time after leading them to victory against England in his first appearance as a captain. On the other hand, skipper Carlos Brathwaite is a national hero for the Caribbean side and will try to turn tides once again to show why they are World Champions. It is going to be an enthralling game as both the sides possess quality batters, bowlers and genuine all-rounders. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to one and all for this exciting contest between Pakistan and West Indies at Dubai (DSC). Both the teams are heading into this 3-match T20I series on a high after their successful T20I outings. UAE is a second home to the Men in Green but the tourists would like to stamp their authority as they are the No. 1 side in T20I cricket.
